notes.title: Lara Croft is Back! Tomb Raider I-III Remastered Out NOW
notes.content:
Tomb Raider I-III Remastered features the original three games, and for the first time available on modern consoles fans can also play: 

[list]
[*] Tomb Raider’s “Unfinished Business” Expansion 
[*] Tomb Raider II’s “The Golden Mask” Expansion 
[*] Tomb Raider III’s “The Lost Artefact” Expansion 
[/list]
[previewyoutube=Q_vH_0gpVlk;full][/previewyoutube]

Tomb Raider I-III Remastered allows fans to toggle between nostalgic 90s graphics and lovingly remastered visuals, and well as classic or modern control schemes. It also includes new features such as photo mode, over 200 trophies, and more.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2478970/Tomb_Raider_IIII_Remastered_Starring_Lara_Croft/]Available Now in the Steam Store[/url]

You can learn more in our recent blog: [url=https://www.tombraider.com/news/video-games/everything-you-need-to-know-about-tomb-raider-i-iii-remastered]Everything you need to Know about Tomb Raider I-III Remastered[/url].
